title: Relative equivalence-prism extension with all vertices prescribed
statement:
Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, equivalence edges and degreewise products of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and pushouts (colimits of spans) of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $p:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a map between quasicategories which lifts every inner horn $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$, $0<i<n$. Let $A\subseteq B$ be a simplicial subset of a small simplicial set, containing every vertex of $B$, and let $\epsilon\in\{0,1\}$. Set
$$P_\epsilon=(\Delta^1\times A)\amalg_{\{\epsilon\}\times A}(\{\epsilon\}\times B).$$
Suppose $h_0:P_\epsilon\to\mathcal C$ and $g:\Delta^1\times B\to\mathcal D$ satisfy $ph_0=g|_{P_\epsilon}$. If for every vertex $b\in B$ the edge $h_0|_{\Delta^1\times\{b\}}$ is an equivalence in $\mathcal C$, then there exists $h:\Delta^1\times B\to\mathcal C$ with $h|_{P_\epsilon}=h_0$ and $ph=g$ exactly.
